title: Add --shout flag to the greet CLI
body:
## Problem

The `greet` CLI always whispers. We need an opt-in loud mode for announcements.

## Done when

- `greet("Ada", { shout: true })` returns `"HELLO, ADA!"` and `greet("Ada")` still returns `"Hello, Ada!"`
- `node cli.js Ada --shout` prints `HELLO, ADA!` and `node cli.js Ada` prints `Hello, Ada!`
- `node check.js` passes
